header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w ASI P.S Umerkot City.
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: Perusal of record reveals that the petitioner through the instant petition has prayed for issuance of directions to the official respondents to take legal action against the private respondents and stop them from drug trafficking. Since it is the duty of the official respondents to take action against the persons involved in drug trafficking, therefore, instant petition is disposed of with direction to the official respondents to act strictly in accordance with law.
